label: Fires at D2 on reaching S2 mid-late episode, stronger after a2-S2-rewarded and confident S2 belief
short_terms: (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) * last_is('a2 S2 r') ;; (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) * (-belief_lo) ;; (in_state == 1) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7])
terms: (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) ;; (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) * (-belief_lo) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * (ep_dec == 4) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * (ep_dec == 4) * (-belief_lo) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 1) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) ;; (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec, [5,6,7]) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * (ep_dec == 8)
explanation: Zero at D1 and GO; active only at D2 when S2 is shown, mostly after choosing a2 (common), and only in episode trials ~50-79 (activation largely multiplicative with episode time, which the additive timing baseline cannot capture). Magnitude grows when the previous trial was a2->S2 rewarded and when the ideal observer is confident S2 is good (negative belief_lo); long streaks of rewarded a2-S2 trials give ~0.6-0.7. Reaching S2 via rare a1 or after a2 S2 unrewarded gives little. The free fit (adding decile-4/8 terms, a1->S2, and the trial-before reward at S2) adds only ~0.01 dev R^2. All terms use observed quantities (at D2 action and state are known).

issues: The recorded short form leaves a large systematic error. On D2 steps where S1 is reached in deciles 5-7, the timing baseline still predicts about 0.13 while the feature is exactly 0 (misses: S1R cells actual 0, predicted 0.126-0.141). Every one of the worst-fit windows shows this. Overall D2 mean error is -0.013, with over-prediction after a1 S2 r (-0.040), a2 S2 u (-0.039) and a1 S1 u (-0.037).

Adding one term that lowers D2-at-S1 in deciles 5-7, (in_state == 1) * isin(ep_dec,[5,6,7]) with weight -0.12, lifts test R^2 beyond timing from 0.455 to 0.592 (dev 0.612). That is well above the recorded free fit (0.465). The misses on that form leave only small residuals (largest +0.042, D2 after a2 S1 r).

The (action == 2) term the label leans on ('mostly after the agent chose a2') adds almost nothing. Dropping it gives test 0.453 against 0.455. Selectivity for a2 is already carried by S2 being reached plus the a2-S2-rewarded history and the S2 belief.

Belief variants do worse: restricting the belief term to action == 2 scores 0.405, and the term alone with action scores 0.405. Hence the belief term really does apply to every S2 arrival in deciles 5-7, not only a2 trials.

Some D2 S2 activations in decile 8 during long a2-S2 rewarded streaks (around t80-83, actual about 0.4-0.5, predicted about 0.02) are missed. Widening the window to deciles 4-8 hurts, though (0.339 / 0.435), so this is a minor residual.

Of the label's claims, these hold: zero at D1 and GO, S2-only at D2, deciles 5-7, raised after a2-S2-rewarded and by S2 belief. The new form shows that S1 arrivals are actively zero, not just at baseline.
